name: symbolic 2D
summary: Fields defined by expressions only, on several 2D planes: bowl and saddle, Rosenbrock, a Gaussian mixture, waves.

name: symbolic 3D
summary: Fields defined by expressions only, on several 3D volumes: spheres and tori, a Gaussian mixture, the gyroid, 3D Rosenbrock.

name: dense sampled landscape
summary: A 25×25 grid of inline samples (a synthetic 'loss'), its exact gradient from the collection phase, an 'accuracy' with a fraction codomain, and derived fields.

name: array-defined fields
summary: Dense fields whose sample arrays are themselves defined symbolically (cell index expressions), constant, or one-hot.

name: iris MLP
summary: A 4-16-3 ReLU MLP trained on iris; validation and training loss / accuracy / per-class loss landscapes around θ* along 2 or 3 random directions (reseed / rescale in Controls).

name: Navier–Stokes blowup (closed-form pieces)
summary: The two closed-form pieces of the 2026 finite-time-blowup construction for 3D Navier–Stokes at one snapshot τ: the exact heat-exterior vortex and the leading-order concentrating core.

name: dynamical systems (textbook)
summary: Textbook continuous dynamical systems ẋ = F(x), one space each: linear zoo, gradient flows, pendulum, Duffing, Van der Pol, Hopf, Lotka–Volterra, competition, saddle-focus, Lorenz, Rössler.

name: symbolic N-D
summary: Symbolic fields on 4D and 5D spaces — Gaussians, quadratic forms, Rosenbrock, waves — viewed through 2D / 3D slices (the slice row of the bundle panel).

name: convnet on mnist: pca landscape
summary: Loss and accuracy of a trained convnet (56,394 parameters) around θ* in the top-3 PCA subspace of its optimizer trajectory: a 40×40×40 float32 volume stored beside the bundle (vol.bin), each channel a `handle` into it.
